`use cargo <crate>` itself is gone with the Rust compiler: no file of core/, extensions/ or lib/ reads it (`use cargo strsim; strsim.levenshtein(…)` → "outside the core: the call levenshtein(…)"), so there is no use reader to give a version to; crates now come as manifests (lib/crates/*.warp, scripts/warp-crate) whose `crate: "regex@1"` line already holds the version. Needs a card for `use cargo` first
